title: 1 million dollarga ham olinmagan sayt...
hook: Ikki yosh asoschi o'z saytini arzonga sotmoqchi bo'ldi.

scenes.text: 1999 yilda ikki yosh asoschi o'z qidiruv saytini sotmoqchi bo'ldi.

scenes.text: Ular uni o'sha paytdagi yirik portal Excite'ga taxminan 1 million dollarga taklif qilishdi.

description:
1999 yilda Larri Peyj va Sergey Brin Google'ni Excite kompaniyasiga taxminan 1 million dollarga taklif qilgan, aytilishicha narx keyin 750 ming dollarga tushirilgan. Excite rahbari Jorj Bell rad etgan. Ma'lumot asosan investor Vinod Xosla'ning 2010 yildagi hikoyasiga tayanadi, tafsilotlar manbaga qarab farq qiladi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-09: TRUE with hedges, kept as 'taxminan' and 'aytiladi' because the story rests on Vinod Khosla's 2010 account, not a contract, and figures vary between tellings. Edits: 'aspirant' replaced by 'yosh asoschi' (Google was incorporated in Sept 1998, so by 1999 they were company founders, no longer just students); removed the claim that Excite went bankrupt in 2001 from the description (it was its parent Excite@Home that filed Chapter 11 on 28 Sep 2001, so the line was imprecise). Sources: TechCrunch, 'When Google Wanted To Sell To Excite For Under $1 Million - And They Passed' (29 Sep 2010), https://techcrunch.com/2010/09/29/google-excite/ ; Fortune, 'Excite passed up buying Google for $750,000 in 1999' (29 Sep 2010), https://fortune.com/2010/09/29/excite-passed-up-buying-google-for-750000-in-1999/ ; CNN Money on Excite@Home bankruptcy (28 Sep 2001), https://money.cnn.com/2001/09/28/deals/excite/index.htm
